confidence_explanation: The timeline shows a clear progression from a brute-force attempt to a successful unauthorized login, followed by privilege escalation, bulk data exfiltration, and anti-forensic activity (log deletion).

attack_chain.description: Brute-force attempt: multiple failed login attempts from an unusual IP (185.220.101.45) against user_04.
Successful unauthorized login for user_04 from the suspicious IP.
Privilege escalation: user_04 successfully elevated their role permissions.
Data exfiltration: bulk download of 13 sensitive finance files following privilege escalation.
Anti-forensics: user_04 deleted authentication logs (/var/log/auth.log) to hide traces of the intrusion.

gaps: Confirmation of whether user_04's credentials were stolen via phishing or if the IP 185.220.101.45 is a known malicious actor.
Verification of whether user_01's cross-department access was a separate incident or unrelated noise.
narrative: An attacker successfully performed a brute-force attack on user_04, gaining access from an external IP. Once inside, the attacker escalated privileges to perform a bulk download of finance documents and subsequently deleted system authentication logs to cover their tracks.
